sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九隐形。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars, and this is the sound of...
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯，这是……的声音

sentences.en: Well, here, I'm going to play you the sound, and if you're old enough, you'll be able to identify it right away.
sentences.zh: 好了，现在我要放一段声音给你听，如果你年纪够大，你马上就能认出来。

sentences.en: That's the sound of a brand new cassette tape being unwrapped and put into a cassette deck.
sentences.zh: 那是崭新的卡式磁带被拆开包装并放入卡式录音座的声音。

sentences.en: That's my friend and fellow Radiotopian, Benjamin Walker.
sentences.zh: 那是我的朋友、同为「放射托邦」成员的本杰明·沃克。

sentences.en: He hosts the show Theory of Everything, and he's definitely old enough to know that sound.
sentences.zh: 他主持了节目《万物理论》，他绝对年龄够大，能听出那个声音。

sentences.en: Yeah, well, so are you, pal.
sentences.zh: 是啊，伙计，你也是。

sentences.en: Benjamin is sitting in a car, a car that happens to have a tape deck, with Andrea Hart, who works with the Sub Pop record label.
sentences.zh: 本杰明坐在一辆刚好有磁带卡座的车里，车上还有在“子流行”唱片公司工作的安德烈娅·哈特。

sentences.en: At first when we started doing the cassettes for every release.
sentences.zh: 起初，当我们开始为每一次发行制作磁带时。

sentences.en: If you're not familiar with Sub Pop, it's kind of this small but really mighty record label that has signed some of the best indie bands of the last 30 years.
sentences.zh: 如果你对“子流行”不熟悉，它是一家规模不大但实力雄厚、签下了过去三十年里一些最优秀独立乐队的唱片公司。

sentences.en: Nirvana, Slater Kenny, The Postal Service, Beach House, and Andrea has a job at Sub Pop that a lot of people might not imagine exists at a modern record label.
sentences.zh: 涅槃乐队、斯莱特·金尼、邮政服务乐队、海滩之屋乐队，而安德烈娅在“子流行”的工作，很多人可能想象不到现代唱片公司里会有这样的岗位。

sentences.en: I work at Sub Pop Records doing cassette production.
sentences.zh: 我在“子流行”唱片公司负责磁带制作。

sentences.en: It's crazy.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: I just don't think I've even held a cassette in my hand for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得我已经很久没把磁带拿在手里了。

sentences.en: This job, handling cassette production at Sub Pop, it disappeared completely for a while.
sentences.zh: 这份工作，也就是在“子流行”负责磁带制作，曾经有一段时间彻底消失了。

sentences.en: But recently, record stores and distributors have been requesting Sub Pop to release their titles on cassette.
sentences.zh: 但最近，唱片店和分销商一直在要求“子流行”发行磁带版的作品。

sentences.en: And Sub Pop asked Andrea to oversee the operation.
sentences.zh: 于是“子流行”让安德烈娅来监督这项业务。

sentences.en: As of 2016, the plan is, for every new release, is to get a cassette release.
sentences.zh: 截至2016年，计划是让每一次的新作品发行都推出磁带版。

sentences.en: I don't like nostalgia for the sake of it.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢为了怀旧而怀旧。

sentences.en: And it's clear to me why cassettes have been replaced now a couple of times over by more convenient mediuMs.
sentences.zh: 而且我很清楚，为什么磁带现在已经被更便捷的媒介取代了好几次。

sentences.en: Mediums where you can actually skip tracks and you don't have to rewind when you're done listening.
sentences.zh: 那种可以真正跳过曲目、听完后不需要倒带的媒介。

sentences.en: But I do think there are a lot of good things about the cassette.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为磁带有很多优点。

sentences.en: First off, you can fix a messed up cassette with some patience and a pencil.
sentences.zh: 首先，只要有一点耐心和一支铅笔，你就可以修复一卷坏掉的磁带。

sentences.en: Plus, there's never been a better way to make a mix.
sentences.zh: 另外，从来没有比这更好的方式来制作混音带了。

sentences.en: And you can have a tape floating around on the floor of your car for years and then throw it in your tape deck and it sounds great.
sentences.zh: 而且你可以把磁带扔在车内地板上好几年不管，然后把它塞进卡座里，听起来还是很棒。

sentences.en: Well, it sounds okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧，听起来还行。

sentences.en: It never really sounded great.
sentences.zh: 它其实从来没有真正听起来很棒过。

sentences.en: In any case, Sub Pop is betting that some of us will want to hear our favorite albums on cassette again.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，“子流行”在赌我们当中会有人想要再次用磁带听自己最喜欢的专辑。

sentences.en: But there is one population that never stopped listening to music on cassette.
sentences.zh: 但有一个群体从未停止用磁带听音乐。

sentences.en: That's filmmaker Alex Lambert.
sentences.zh: 那就是电影制作人亚历克斯·兰伯特。

sentences.en: We've been working together on this story.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在合作这个故事。

sentences.en: And actually, I'm just going to hand it over to her now.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我接下来就要把话筒交给她了。

sentences.en: The United States prison system has the largest prison population in the world.
sentences.zh: 美国的监狱系统拥有世界上最多的囚犯人口。

sentences.en: And when the more than two million prisoners in this country have access to music, it's often on cassette.
sentences.zh: 而当这个国家超过二百万的囚犯能够接触到音乐时，通常都是通过磁带。

sentences.en: Well, my number one thing to keep around here is my walkman, my tapes, my legal papers, and some bottled water.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我在这里最离不开的东西是我的随身听、我的磁带、我的法律文件，还有一些瓶装水。

sentences.en: Yeah, they can have everything else.
sentences.zh: 是的，其他东西他们都可以拿走。

sentences.en: That's Adolfo Davis.
sentences.zh: 那是阿道夫·戴维斯。

sentences.en: At 14 years old, he was involved in a gang-related shooting.
sentences.zh: 在他14岁的时候，他卷入了一场帮派枪击案。

sentences.en: He was tried as an adult and sentenced to life in prison.
sentences.zh: 他被作为成年人审判并被判处终身监禁。

sentences.en: Adolfo is 39 now, and he's serving his sentence at Stateville Correctional Center in Illinois.
sentences.zh: 阿道夫现在39岁了，他正在伊利诺伊州的斯蒂特维尔惩教中心服刑。

sentences.en: Listening to music on tapes is one of his only means of escape.
sentences.zh: 用磁带听音乐是他仅有的逃避现实的途径之一。

sentences.en: That's the only way I think I've made it so far, because I have a good imagination.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是我坚持到今天的唯一方式，因为我有很好的想象力。

sentences.en: And I just close my eyes, put my earbuds in, and I'll just be gone.
sentences.zh: 我只要闭上眼睛，塞上耳机，然后就会神游物外。

sentences.en: In 1990, the year Adolfo was incarcerated, everybody was listening to music on cassette tapes.
sentences.zh: 1990年，阿道夫入狱的那年，每个人都在用磁带听音乐。

sentences.en: In fact, Adolfo had some with him when he went to prison.
sentences.zh: 事实上，阿道夫进监狱时随身带了一些磁带。

sentences.en: Yeah, I got locked up with a walkman and I think like seven tapes.
sentences.zh: 对，我被关进去的时候带了一个随身听和大概七盘磁带。

sentences.en: Yeah, when I used to sell drugs, I'd have a fanny pack.
sentences.zh: 对，我以前卖毒品的时候，会带一个腰包。

sentences.en: And I'd have my walkman in my fanny pack with my tape.
sentences.zh: 我的腰包里会装着随身听和磁带。

sentences.en: And I'd be listening to the walkman while I'm watching out for security for the police.
sentences.zh: 我一边听着随身听，一边帮着放哨提防警察的安保人员。

sentences.en: A fanny pack.
sentences.zh: 一个腰包。

sentences.en: We used to call it a pouch, but it's a fanny pack.
sentences.zh: 我们以前管它叫小包，但这就是个腰包。

sentences.en: Let's be real.
sentences.zh: 说实话吧。

sentences.en: Just a few years after Adolfo was locked up, the cassette tape would be all but replaced by the CD out here in the free world.
sentences.zh: 就在阿道夫被关进去几年后，在外面自由的世界里，磁带几乎完全被CD取代了。

sentences.en: But in prison, the cassette lived on.
sentences.zh: 但在监狱里，磁带存活了下来。

sentences.en: I'd be telling my family, like, I need to order a tape.
sentences.zh: 我会告诉我的家人，比如，我需要订购一盘磁带。

sentences.en: And the younger generation that I'd be talking to, they don't even know what a tape is.
sentences.zh: 而我与之交谈的年轻一代，他们甚至不知道磁带是什么。

sentences.en: And not just any old cassette tape is allowed in prison.
sentences.zh: 并不是随便什么旧磁带都能带进监狱的。

sentences.en: Some prisons require a very specific type of cassette tape.
sentences.zh: 有些监狱要求非常特定类型的磁带。

sentences.en: It has to be clear.
sentences.zh: 它必须是透明的。

sentences.en: It has to be sonically welded so it can't be taken apart and put back together.
sentences.zh: 它必须是超声波焊接的，这样就无法拆开又重新组装。

sentences.en: And the box it goes in has to also be perfectly clear.
sentences.zh: 而且装它的盒子也必须完全透明。

sentences.en: That's Steve Stepp, owner of National Audio Company, America's preeminent manufacturer of cassette tapes.
sentences.zh: 那是史蒂夫·斯特普，美国卓越的磁带制造商国家音频公司的老板。

sentences.en: The reason you can't have a five-screw cassette or maybe a colored cassette that's opaque is they don't want a razor blade or narcotics or something else to be enclosed in a cassette.
sentences.zh: 你不能用五颗螺丝的磁带，或者那种不透明的彩色磁带，原因在于他们不希望刀片、毒品或其他东西被藏在磁带里。

sentences.en: They do have people in the correctional facilities who look at and inspect incoming materials, and they have to be able to see through or they won't allow them in.
sentences.zh: 惩教设施里确实有专门查看和检查进仓物品的人员，他们必须能够看透，否则不会允许带入。

sentences.en: Steve has gotten familiar with this subfield of cassette tape manufacturing, even though it is not the focus of his business.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫已经熟悉了磁带制造的这个细分领域，尽管这不是他业务的重点。

sentences.en: Mostly he makes normal cassette tapes for a number of different markets.
sentences.zh: 他主要为许多不同的市场制作普通磁带。

sentences.en: Music labels, spoken word, audio books.
sentences.zh: 音乐唱片、有声读物、有声书。

sentences.en: Steve's factory in Springfield, Missouri, produces both blank tapes and tapes with audio already on them.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫位于密苏里州斯普林菲尔德的工厂既生产空白磁带，也生产已经录好音频的磁带。

sentences.en: Machines collate all those parts together, transfer them across on a conveyor, and then wrap them with cellophane and put a tear strip in.
sentences.zh: 机器将所有这些零件组合在一起，通过传送带运送，然后用玻璃纸包装并装上易撕带。

sentences.en: Steve was one of the first people in the cassette industry.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫是磁带行业最早的一批从业者之一。

sentences.en: And he's one of the only people still in it.
sentences.zh: 而且他是仍在坚持的少数人之一。

sentences.en: And we're the only people I know of.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，我们是仅存的。

sentences.en: Most of the people left in the cassette industry are mom-and-pop shops or small operations.
sentences.zh: 磁带行业里剩下的大多数人都是夫妻店或小型企业。

sentences.en: If you purchased a cassette recently from anywhere, from Radio Shack or from the merch table of some punk band you just saw live, it probably started out in Steve's factory.
sentences.zh: 如果你最近在任何地方买过磁带，无论是从无线电沙克还是从你刚看过的某支朋克乐队的周边摊位买的，它很可能最初就产自史蒂夫的工厂。

sentences.en: His company ships out up to 100,000 cassettes a day.
sentences.zh: 他的公司每天发运多达十万盘磁带。

sentences.en: And a small number of those cassettes are special orders for prisoners, made with clear plastic and without screws.
sentences.zh: 其中少部分是专门为囚犯定制的订单，采用透明塑料制造且不含螺丝。

sentences.en: Once the tapes leave here, we don't really see where they end up.
sentences.zh: 一旦磁带从这里运走，我们就真的不知道它们最终流向哪里了。

sentences.en: As for why cassettes have stuck around in prisons all these years, it's hard to get a definitive answer because every prison is different.
sentences.zh: 至于为什么磁带能在监狱里保留这么多年，很难得到一个确切的答案，因为每个监狱都不一样。

sentences.en: But there's one theory we heard from a few different people.
sentences.zh: 但我们从不同的人那里听到了一种理论。

sentences.en: Tapes are allowed because CDs are easier to weaponize.
sentences.zh: 之所以允许磁带，是因为CD更容易被制成武器。

sentences.en: They say that it's the most safest way for them to listen to music.
sentences.zh: 他们说这是囚犯听音乐最安全的方式。

sentences.en: There's a CD you could break and maybe cut somebody with.
sentences.zh: 如果有张CD，你可以把它弄碎，也许能割伤别人。

sentences.en: That's Chris Barrett.
sentences.zh: 那是克里斯·巴雷特。

sentences.en: This tape of him was recorded a couple years ago for a short film.
sentences.zh: 这段录音是他几年前为一部短片录制的。

sentences.en: Chris used to run a service that helped families send packages to people in prison in New York state.
sentences.zh: 克里斯过去曾经营过一项服务，帮助纽约州的家属给监狱里的亲人寄送包裹。

sentences.en: He had a warehouse full of items that had already been approved by the prison authorities.
sentences.zh: 他的仓库里堆满了已经获得监狱当局批准的物品。

sentences.en: Everything from food, clothing, boxer shorts, and, yeah, cassettes instead of CDs.
sentences.zh: 从食物、衣物、平角内裤，到没错，替代CD的磁带。

sentences.en: But he never really understood the logic behind it.
sentences.zh: 但他从来没有真正理解背后的逻辑。

sentences.en: They let me sell tuna fish cans that, you know, you pull off the top and that thing is metal.
sentences.zh: 他们允许我卖金枪鱼罐头，你知道的，你把顶部拉开，那东西是金属的。

sentences.en: Like, it's much more dangerous than a CD is my point, the tuna fish can than a CD.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，金枪鱼罐头比CD危险得多，相比CD而言。

sentences.en: So I don't know why they come up with some of the rules that they come up with.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道他们怎么会想出那些规章制度。

sentences.en: We just try to stay within those guidelines.
sentences.zh: 我们只是努力遵守这些准则。

sentences.en: Chris, whose package sending service recently went out of business, also sold a lot of cassette Walkmans.
sentences.zh: 克里斯的包裹寄送服务最近倒闭了，他还卖过很多卡带随身听。

sentences.en: Walkmans used to be available for purchase in prison commissaries, but they generally aren't anymore,
sentences.zh: 随身听过去可以在监狱的小卖部买到，但现在通常买不到了，

sentences.en: which makes them extremely coveted iteMs.
sentences.zh: 这使得它们成了极其抢手的物品。

sentences.en: Like, if my Walkman breaks, I'm out of there, so I take good care of it.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果我的随身听坏了，我就彻底完了，所以我很爱护它。

sentences.en: Because if it breaks, it, like, I start crying.
sentences.zh: 因为如果它坏了，我会，就像要哭出来一样。

sentences.en: And wear and tear is not the only threat to the life of a Walkman.
sentences.zh: 而且日常磨损并不是对随身听寿命的唯一威胁。

sentences.en: But when it's like a major shakedown and they bring other officers from other institutions,
sentences.zh: 但当进行大规模突击搜查、他们从其他机构调来其他警官时，

sentences.en: they will just break your TV, break your radio, take your TV, take your radio, take your cassette tape.
sentences.zh: 他们会直接砸碎你的电视，砸碎你的收音机，拿走你的电视，拿走你的收音机，拿走你的磁带。

sentences.en: Once you destroy my Walkman, I cannot get another Walkman.
sentences.zh: 一旦你毁了我的随身听，我就搞不到另一个随身听了。

sentences.en: It's probably one of the most prized for theft.
sentences.zh: 这可能是最容易招致偷盗的目标之一。

sentences.en: That's Efren Paredes Jr.
sentences.zh: 那是埃夫伦·帕雷德斯二世。

sentences.en: He was a 15-year-old honor student when he was tried as an adult on a murder charge
sentences.zh: 他曾是一名15岁的荣誉学生，当时他因谋杀指控被作为成年人审判，

sentences.en: and sentenced to life without parole.
sentences.zh: 并被判处不得假释的终身监禁。

sentences.en: He's always maintained his innocence.
sentences.zh: 他一直坚称自己是无辜的。

sentences.en: Efren is 43 now, and during his 28 years in prison, he amassed a pretty big collection of music.
sentences.zh: 埃夫伦现在43岁了，在监狱度过的28年里，他积攒了相当多的音乐收藏。

sentences.en: So my favorite, Kendrick Lamar, I like Young Jeezy, Rick Ross, Meek Mills, I like Lil Wayne.
sentences.zh: 所以我最喜欢的有肯德里克·拉马尔，我喜欢杨·吉齐、里克·罗斯、米克·米尔斯，我喜欢李尔·韦恩。

sentences.en: At Muskegon Correctional Facility in Michigan, where Efren is serving his sentence,
sentences.zh: 在埃夫伦服刑的密歇根州马斯凯贡惩教中心，

sentences.en: prisoners can actually have MP3 players.
sentences.zh: 囚犯其实可以拥有MP3播放器。

sentences.en: Inmates can purchase an MP3 player through the prison commissary
sentences.zh: 犯人可以通过监狱小卖部购买MP3播放器，

sentences.en: and then download music to it through a kiosk provided by a company called Access Entertainment.
sentences.zh: 然后通过一家名为“接入娱乐”的公司提供的自助终端将音乐下载到里面。

sentences.en: Before downloading, they have to transfer money to the company
sentences.zh: 在下载之前，他们必须向该公司转账，

sentences.en: and receive a credit for a certain amount of songs.
sentences.zh: 并获得一定数量歌曲的点数。

sentences.en: But there's a catch.
sentences.zh: 但有个问题。

sentences.en: In Michigan, there's a policy that they try to restrict as much music
sentences.zh: 在密歇根州，有一项政策试图尽可能限制那些

sentences.en: that would be labeled as parental advisory.
sentences.zh: 被贴上“家长指引”标签的音乐。

sentences.en: In other words, the state of Michigan will try and sentence a 15-year-old as an adult,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，密歇根州会试图把一个15岁的孩子当作成年人判刑，

sentences.en: but when he becomes an actual adult,
sentences.zh: 但当他真正成为成年人时，

sentences.en: the state won't let him purchase music deemed inappropriate for a teenager.
sentences.zh: 州政府却不让他购买被认为不适合青少年的音乐。

sentences.en: It's interesting that the corrections has never had any steps to...
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，惩教部门从来没有采取任何步骤去……

sentences.en: We couldn't confirm that there were no restrictions on cassette music, but Efren hasn't encountered them.
sentences.zh: 我们无法证实磁带音乐没有任何限制，但埃夫伦没有遇到过。

sentences.en: And that's why he says a lot of inmates still prefer cassettes.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么他说很多犯人仍然更喜欢磁带。

sentences.en: They listen to them all the time, on their personal Walkmans and sometimes out loud.
sentences.zh: 他们随时随地都在听，用他们自己的随身听，有时还外放出来。

sentences.en: Actually, as we're talking right now, there's a gentleman in the bathroom washing clothes with his radio on,
sentences.zh: 事实上，就在我们交谈的时候，浴室里正有一个老兄一边洗衣服一边开着收音机，

sentences.en: playing the song Play At Your Own WriSt.
sentences.zh: 放着那首《自担风险》。

sentences.en: Right underneath the part of the prison where Efren is locked up
sentences.zh: 就在埃夫伦被关押的监狱区域的正下方，

sentences.en: is the wing that houses the prisoners in solitary confinement.
sentences.zh: 是关押单独禁闭犯人的侧翼监区。

sentences.en: We hear guys all the time yelling up to us saying,
sentences.zh: 我们经常听到那里的家伙朝上面大喊大叫，说：

sentences.en: hey, turn the music on, turn some music on, you know, turn on, turn Rick Ross on,
sentences.zh: 嘿，把音乐放开点，放点音乐，你知道的，放点里克·罗斯的歌，

sentences.en: or turn on Meek Mill, or...
sentences.zh: 或者放点米克·米尔斯，或者……

sentences.en: Ain't this what they've been waiting for?
sentences.zh: 这难道不是他们一直期盼的吗？

sentences.en: You know, something so that they can hear down there...
sentences.zh: 你知道，弄点声音好让他们在下面能听到……

sentences.en: You ready?
sentences.zh: 准备好了吗？

sentences.en: Something that's, you know, music from upstairs.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就是楼上传来的音乐。

sentences.en: Uh, I used to pray for times like this, to rhyme like this,
sentences.zh: 呃，我曾祈祷能有这样的时光，能这样押韵，

sentences.en: so I had to grind like that, to shine like this,
sentences.zh: 所以我必须那样打拼，才能像这样闪耀，

sentences.en: in a matter of time I spent on some locked-ups-ish,
sentences.zh: 在我度过的那些铁窗生涯里，

sentences.en: in the back of the paddy wagon, cuffs locked on wrists,
sentences.zh: 坐在囚车后面，手腕拷着手铐，

sentences.en: see my dreams unfold, nightmares come true, it was time to marry...
sentences.zh: 看着我的梦想展开，噩梦成真，是时候与……结合了

sentences.en: Prisons tend to be late adopters of technology,
sentences.zh: 监狱往往是技术的晚期采纳者，

sentences.en: so maybe one day all prisons in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以也许有一天美国所有的监狱

sentences.en: will just make the switch from cassette to digital.
sentences.zh: 都会直接从磁带转向数字化。

sentences.en: Or maybe they'll go to CDs first, just to be illogically chronological.
sentences.zh: 或者他们也许会先过渡到CD，纯粹为了不合逻辑的按时间顺序来。

sentences.en: Whatever the format, the most important thing about music to Ephraim and Adolfo
sentences.zh: 无论什么格式，对埃弗雷姆和阿道夫来说，音乐最重要的意义

sentences.en: is escape and connection.
sentences.zh: 是逃离现实与建立联系。

sentences.en: Here's Adolfo again.
sentences.zh: 下面再次请出阿道夫。

sentences.en: Music connects us all together.
sentences.zh: 音乐把我们所有人连接在一起。

sentences.en: Everybody shares music with each other.
sentences.zh: 每个人都与彼此分享音乐。

sentences.en: You know, music allows everyone to escape from this place.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，音乐让每个人都能从这个地方逃离片刻。

sentences.en: I can't, I can't do it without my music.
sentences.zh: 我不能，我没有音乐简直活不下去。

sentences.en: In the days I rest my walkman,
sentences.zh: 在我让随身听休息的日子里，

sentences.en: I'll borrow a walkman from somebody else to live to stay walkman
sentences.zh: 我会向别人借个随身听来继续听随身听的习惯

sentences.en: before I can go to sleep, but...
sentences.zh: 直到入睡前，不过……

sentences.en: The days that you don't have your walkman?
sentences.zh: 那些你没有随身听的日子呢？

sentences.en: No, like, I play my walkman like three days,
sentences.zh: 不，我是说，我用随身听大概用三天，

sentences.en: then I let it rest like two days.
sentences.zh: 然后让它休息个两天。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: He rests his walkman.
sentences.zh: 他让他的随身听休息。

sentences.en: That is love.
sentences.zh: 这就是真爱。

sentences.en: 99% Invincible was produced this week by Benjamin Walker and Alex Lambert
sentences.zh: 本周的《99%无形》由本杰明·沃克和亚历克斯·兰伯特制作

sentences.en: with Katie Mingle, Sam Greenspan, Sharif Youssef,
sentences.zh: 合作制片人有凯蒂·明格尔、萨姆·格林斯潘、谢里夫·优素福、

sentences.en: Kurt Kohlstead, Delaney Hall, Avery Truffleman, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 库尔特·科尔斯特德、德兰尼·霍尔、艾弗里·特鲁夫曼，还有我，罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: The audio you heard from Chris Barrett, the guy who sent packages to prisoners,
sentences.zh: 你听到的克里斯·巴雷特的音频——那个给囚犯寄包裹的人——

sentences.en: was from the film The Prison in Twelve Landscapes by Brett Story.
sentences.zh: 取自布雷特·斯托里的电影《十二个风景中的监狱》。

sentences.en: For more information about where and how to see that film,
sentences.zh: 有关何地以及如何观看该电影的更多信息，

sentences.en: go to prisonlandscapes.com.
sentences.zh: 请访问 prisonlandscapes.com。

sentences.zh: 特别感谢埃利斯·布伦纳-哈塞特。

sentences.en: She introduced us to both Adolfo and Ephraim.
sentences.zh: 她把阿道夫和埃夫赖姆介绍给了我们。

sentences.en: A slightly different version of the story will air on Benjamin Walker's Theory of Everything.
sentences.zh: 该故事的一个略有不同的版本将在本杰明·沃克的《万物理论》中播出。

sentences.en: Benjamin is one of my oldest friends in radio,
sentences.zh: 本杰明是我在广播界最老的朋友之一，

sentences.en: and you should definitely be friends with him too.
sentences.zh: 你绝对也应该和他交朋友。

sentences.en: But in case you don't already listen,
sentences.zh: 但如果你还没听过的话，

sentences.en: this is one of my favorite clips from his program
sentences.zh: 这是我最喜欢的他的节目的片段之一，

sentences.en: that has a little bit more Benjamin Walker in it.
sentences.zh: 其中包含了更多本杰明·沃克的风格。

sentences.en: Enjoy.
sentences.zh: 请欣赏。

sentences.en: There's this painting that I keep with me, always.
sentences.zh: 有一幅画我一直带在身边。

sentences.en: It's one of those little postcard reproductions.
sentences.zh: 那是那种明信片大小的复制品之一。

sentences.en: I've even made a gold frame for it out of balsa wood.
sentences.zh: 我甚至用轻木为它做了一个金框。

sentences.en: The painting is called The Artist in His Studio.
sentences.zh: 这幅画叫做《画室里的艺术家》。

sentences.en: It's by John Singer Sargent.
sentences.zh: 作者是约翰·辛格·萨金特。

sentences.en: I've brought it with me here to the studio.
sentences.zh: 我把它带到了这里的录音室。

sentences.en: I have it right here in front of me,
sentences.zh: 我就把它放在我面前，

sentences.en: propped up next to the microphone.
sentences.zh: 靠在麦克风旁边。

sentences.en: The painting depicts a man painting a picture in his studio.
sentences.zh: 画中描绘了一个人在自己的画室里作画。

sentences.en: But this artist's studio is not an ordinary studio.
sentences.zh: 但这位艺术家的画室并非普通的画室。

sentences.en: It is the artist's home.
sentences.zh: 那是艺术家的家。

sentences.en: The man has his painting propped up on the bed and the bureau.
sentences.zh: 那人把画靠在床铺和五斗橱上。

sentences.en: There is no easel.
sentences.zh: 这里没有画架。

sentences.en: You get the idea that the only things in the room
sentences.zh: 你会觉得房间里仅有的东西

sentences.en: are the bed, the bureau, and the chair upon which the man sits.
sentences.zh: 就是床、五斗橱，以及那人坐的椅子。

sentences.en: The man is confined to extremely small quarters.
sentences.zh: 这个人局促在极其狭小的空间里。

sentences.en: The setting is grim,
sentences.zh: 环境阴暗凄凉，

sentences.en: and it contrasts with the painting that the man is working on.
sentences.zh: 与这名男子正在创作的画作形成了鲜明对比。

sentences.en: A landscape.
sentences.zh: 一幅风景画。

sentences.en: The man is painting a landscape.
sentences.zh: 这个人正在画一幅风景画。

sentences.en: Horses meander through a soft green meadow,
sentences.zh: 骏马在柔嫩的绿色草地上漫步，

sentences.en: and the trees are lush and full,
sentences.zh: 树木葱郁茂密，

sentences.en: and the blue horizon is dotted with clouds.
sentences.zh: 蔚蓝的地平线上点缀着朵朵白云。

sentences.en: Most Sargent commentators dismiss this painting.
sentences.zh: 大多数萨金特的评论家都对这幅画不屑一顾。

sentences.en: They consider it to be nothing but a silly joke.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这不过是个无聊的玩笑。

sentences.en: An artist painting a landscape in his cramped, doleful bedroom.
sentences.zh: 一个艺术家竟然在他那逼仄、忧郁的卧室里画风景画。

sentences.en: But I consider this painting to be a masterpiece.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这幅画是一杰作。

sentences.en: Because it captures the idea that through art,
sentences.zh: 因为它捕捉到了这样一种理念：通过艺术，

sentences.en: man is able to transcend his dismal, squalid surroundings.
sentences.zh: 人类能够超越他那凄凉、肮脏的周围环境。

sentences.en: This painting is not a joke.
sentences.zh: 这幅画不是个玩笑。

sentences.en: This artist is not painting a landscape.
sentences.zh: 这位艺术家画的不是风景。

sentences.en: This artist is painting a window.
sentences.zh: 这位艺术家画的是一扇窗户。

sentences.en: Look out this window for a moment.
sentences.zh: 请看一眼这扇窗外。

sentences.en: Here, let me move out of your way.
sentences.zh: 来，让我让开一点。

sentences.en: You'll find the view is breathtaking.
sentences.zh: 你会发现那景色美得令人窒息。

sentences.en: I've spent my entire life looking for the way
sentences.zh: 我一生都在寻找通往

sentences.en: to get to the other side of this window.
sentences.zh: 这扇窗户另一端的方法。

sentences.en: I've been told time and time again
sentences.zh: 一次又一次有人告诉我

sentences.en: that I'm wasting my efforts.
sentences.zh: 我在白费力气。

sentences.en: But I've never given up.
sentences.zh: 但我从未放弃过。

sentences.en: I've always known that there is a way
sentences.zh: 我一直坚信有这样一条路

sentences.en: to break the glass and crawl out over the windowsill.
sentences.zh: 可以打破玻璃，爬上窗台。

sentences.en: I've always been certain of it.
sentences.zh: 对此我深信不疑。

sentences.en: And I made a vow that I would never give up
sentences.zh: 我曾发誓，在找到这个秘密之前

sentences.en: until I discovered the secret.
sentences.zh: 我绝不放弃。

sentences.en: You're snickering at me.
sentences.zh: 你在冲我窃笑。

sentences.en: Well, go ahead and laugh.
sentences.zh: 好吧，尽管笑吧。

sentences.en: You think I'm crazy for believing
sentences.zh: 你觉得我疯了，才会相信

sentences.en: that there's something on the other side of this window.
sentences.zh: 这扇窗户的另一边有什么东西。

sentences.en: Well, I'm not.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我没疯。

sentences.en: The reality on the other side
sentences.zh: 另一边的现实

sentences.en: is just as real as the one we stand in right now.
sentences.zh: 和我们现在站立的这个现实一样真实。

sentences.en: Now, sometimes I think it's even more real.
sentences.zh: 有时候，我觉得它甚至更加真实。

sentences.en: But we do not have to go into that now.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在不必讨论这个。

sentences.en: I have not brought you here to this window
sentences.zh: 我把你带到这扇窗前

sentences.en: to discuss the metaphysics of reality.
sentences.zh: 不是为了讨论现实的形而上学。

sentences.en: I have brought you here to this window
sentences.zh: 我把你带到这扇窗前

sentences.en: because I need your help.
sentences.zh: 是因为我需要你的帮助。

sentences.en: You see, I believe that I have finally discovered the secret.
sentences.zh: 你看，我相信我终于发现了这个秘密。

sentences.en: So I'm going to go to the other side of the studio now.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我要走到画室的另一头。

sentences.en: And I need you to kneel down here in the front.
sentences.zh: 而你需要在这里的前面跪下。

sentences.en: I'm going to count to three.
sentences.zh: 我要数到三。

sentences.en: And on three, I'm going to run towards you.
sentences.zh: 数到三时，我会向你跑去。

sentences.en: And you are going to lift me into the air.
sentences.zh: 然后你要把我托举到空中。

sentences.en: You are going to catapult me through the window.
sentences.zh: 你要把我当成投石机一样从窗户扔出去。

sentences.en: Trust me, this is going to work.
sentences.zh: 相信我，这绝对行得通。

sentences.en: With your help, I am going to break the glass
sentences.zh: 在你的帮助下，我将打破玻璃

sentences.en: and land on the other side.
sentences.zh: 并降落在另一边。

sentences.en: So, on three.
sentences.zh: 那么，数到三。

sentences.en: One, two, three.
sentences.zh: 一，二，三。

sentences.en: That's the introduction to Something Will Happen Soon.
sentences.zh: 以上是《不久将有大事发生》的引子。

sentences.en: An episode from Benjamin Walker's Theory of Everything
sentences.zh: 这是来自 Radiotopia 的

sentences.en: from Radiotopia.
sentences.zh: 本杰明·沃克的《万物理论》中的一集。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible is a project of KALW 91.7 in San Francisco
sentences.zh: 《99%无形》是旧金山 KALW 91.7 的一个项目

sentences.en: and produced out of the offices of ArcSign,
sentences.zh: 制作于 ArcSign 的办公室，

sentences.en: an architecture and interiors firm
sentences.zh: ArcSign 是一家建筑与室内设计公司，

sentences.en: in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 位于加利福尼亚州奥克兰市美丽的市中心。

sentences.en: You can find this show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 Facebook 上找到并关注这个节目。

sentences.en: You can follow us all on Twitter and Instagram.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 Twitter 和 Instagram 上关注我们所有人。

sentences.en: But the best way to explore the 99% invisible activity
sentences.zh: 但探索塑造我们世界设计的

sentences.en: that shapes the design of our world
sentences.zh: 99%无形活动的最佳方式

sentences.en: is to spend as much time as possible
sentences.zh: 是尽可能多地花时间

sentences.en: on 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 浏览 99pi.org。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
